I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal date is 25 November.

That's the date Ilse posted in #north-team on 14 Oct. Marcus is a member of that channel, so he can see her message himself. Nothing has been posted in #north-team since then that changes the date. A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so sharing it with the North team needs no approval.
